translation: > 本腳本並非建立在 Finding 框架（`QC/validation/_finding.py`）之上。

english: > Two families of per-language files silently change what the validators find and what phonology gets written: the attestation dictionaries under `QC/validation/reference/<Language>/`, and the phonology rule sidecars under `Orthographies/<Scheme>/<Language>.rules.tsv`.
translation: > 有兩類各語言檔案會在不知不覺中改變驗證器找到的內容以及寫入的音韻：`QC/validation/reference/<Language>/` 下的佐證辭典，以及 `Orthographies/<Scheme>/<Language>.rules.tsv` 下的音韻規則附屬檔。

english: > `audio_sources.json` and `audio_permissions.json` are the two hand-maintained files that describe every FormosanBank audio dataset.
translation: > `audio_sources.json` 與 `audio_permissions.json` 是描述每個 FormosanBank 錄音資料集的兩個人工維護檔案。

english: A 1200 dpi reading of `Original.pdf` p.19, example 14 shows the diacritic as a caron, the same mark the typescript puts on every `ř`, which would make the letter `f` + U+030C.
translation: 以 1200 dpi 判讀 `Original.pdf` 第 19 頁的例句 14，顯示該附加符號是抑揚符（caron），也就是打字稿在每個 `ř` 上所加的同一個符號，這會使該字母成為 `f` + U+030C。

english: A 2024 recording replaced by a different 2026 one becomes untranscribed audio.
translation: 被不同的 2026 年錄音取代的 2024 年錄音成為未轉寫錄音。

english: A 2026 recording is named after its `S` (`Bunun_1995-opt.mp3`), with the extension of its real type: 2,162 are WebM (`.webm`) and 16 MP4 (`.mp4`); they are not converted.
translation: 2026 年的錄音以其 `S` 命名（`Bunun_1995-opt.mp3`），副檔名依其實際類型：2,162 個為 WebM（`.webm`），16 個為 MP4（`.mp4`）；不做轉換。

english: A 2026-08-23 audit matched all 668 frozen source URLs against all 846 posts in the live Blogger feed.
translation: 2026-08-23 的稽核將全部 668 個凍結的來源 URL 與即時 Blogger feed 中的全部 846 篇文章比對。

english: A Chinese translation that only adds a page reference (`18頁 上帝的話必萬世長存` next to `上帝的話必萬世長存`) is dropped (ruling: "One translation, drop the page"): 18 copies; 19 `N頁` translations with no clean twin stay.
translation: 只多了頁碼參照的中文翻譯（`18頁 上帝的話必萬世長存` 對照 `上帝的話必萬世長存`）會被刪除（裁定："One translation, drop the page"）：共 18 個副本；19 個沒有乾淨對應版本的 `N頁` 翻譯則保留。

english: A FORM `notes` attribute keeps the source cell only where it carries content beyond the corrected text: the full cell of a split slash cell, and S1193's stray English `Literally`.
translation: FORM 的 `notes` 屬性只在來源儲存格含有更正文字之外的內容時才保留該儲存格：即被拆分之斜線儲存格的完整內容，以及 S1193 中多出的英文 `Literally`。

english: A FORM is never emptied; the one known marker-only morpheme (`L2M-L2M` under Kanakanavu `kkvNr_dailylife_Angai_S_11_W0`, with its echo-gloss sibling) is left as-is and reported on every run — it needs a structural (manual) fix.
translation: FORM 從不會被清空；唯一已知只含標記的詞素（Kanakanavu `kkvNr_dailylife_Angai_S_11_W0` 下的 `L2M-L2M`，及其重複詞義的同層元素）保持原樣，並在每次執行時回報 — 它需要結構性的（人工）修正。

english: A FORM that is nothing but `<UNCLEAR/>` has no lower tiers: an S whose FORM is only `<UNCLEAR/>` has no W, and a W whose FORM is only `<UNCLEAR/>` has no M. Word counts read the whole FORM, so words after an inline `<UNCLEAR/>` are counted and the gap is not.
translation: 只含 `<UNCLEAR/>` 的 FORM 沒有下層：FORM 只有 `<UNCLEAR/>` 的 S 沒有 W，FORM 只有 `<UNCLEAR/>` 的 W 沒有 M。詞數計算讀取整個 FORM，因此行內 `<UNCLEAR/>` 之後的詞會被計入，而缺漏部分不計。

english: A Git-free export can supply its verified revision through `FORMOSANBANK_COMMIT`; absent revision information leaves the last reviewed provenance unchanged and prints a notice.
translation: 不含 Git 的匯出版本可透過 `FORMOSANBANK_COMMIT` 提供其已驗證的版本；若沒有版本資訊，則保留上次審閱的建置來源紀錄不變，並印出提示。

english: A Git-free export retains its supplied provenance.
translation: 不含 Git 的匯出版本保留其所附的來源紀錄。

english: A Git-free export retains that provenance record.
translation: 不含 Git 的匯出版本會保留該來源紀錄。

english: A Git-free export retains that record and requires independent verification of its tools revision.
translation: 不含 Git 的匯出版本會保留該記錄，並需要另行獨立驗證其工具版本。

english: A Git-free export retains that record.
translation: 不含 Git 的匯出版本會保留該紀錄。

english: A Git-free export retains this provenance record.
translation: 不含 Git 的匯出版本會保留此來源記錄。

english: A GitHub token is optional for public data.
translation: 對公開資料而言，GitHub 權杖（token）是選用的。

english: A HARD finding that a human has read and accepted is recorded in the corpus's `CodeAndDocs/qc_waivers.tsv` — one fixed path, tab-separated, columns `rule_id`, `file` (relative to the corpus `XML/`), `location`, `reason`.
translation: 經人閱讀並接受的 HARD 檢查結果，記錄在該語料庫的 `CodeAndDocs/qc_waivers.tsv` 中——一個固定路徑，以 Tab 分隔，欄位為 `rule_id`、`file`（相對於語料庫的 `XML/`）、`location`、`reason`。

english: A Legacy of Suppression and Revitalization
translation: 受壓抑與復振的語言

english: A PDF is available from the Australian National University repository, which also provides the grammatical and cultural context for the texts.
translation: 澳洲國立大學的典藏庫提供 PDF，並提供這些文本的語法與文化背景。

english: A Pazeh scheme does exist in the bank (`Orthographies/Tsuchida/Pazeh.tsv`), but it describes a different orthography: it has no `c`, `j` or `o`, all of which Sato uses, and applying it produces both unmapped letters and silent errors.
translation: 本資料庫中確實有一套巴宰語方案（`Orthographies/Tsuchida/Pazeh.tsv`），但它描述的是另一套書寫系統：它沒有 Sato 使用的 `c`、`j` 或 `o`，套用它會同時產生未對應的字母與不易察覺的錯誤。

english: A Rich Linguistic Landscape
translation: 豐富的語言景觀

english: A SHA transcribed into prose is a second copy that drifts.
translation: 轉抄進說明文字中的 SHA 是會漂移的第二份副本。

english: A W gloss is then reconstructed from its M glosses wherever every M is glossed.
translation: 接著，凡是每個 M 都有詞義標注的詞，就從其 M 詞義標注重建 W 詞義標注。

english: A W or M here carries no TRANSL.
translation: 此處的 W 或 M 不帶 TRANSL。

english: A W tier (and an M tier where a word carries `-` boundaries) is added only when the FORM contains none of `( ) / ~ [ ]`.
translation: 只有當 FORM 不含 `( ) / ~ [ ]` 中任何一個時，才會加入 W 層（以及在詞帶有 `-` 邊界時加入 M 層）。

english: A W with exactly one M asserts that the word is monomorphemic.
translation: 恰好只有一個 M 的 W 表示該詞為單一詞素。

english: A W with no M means its segmentation is unknown, which is legitimate.
translation: 沒有 M 的 W 表示其切分未知，這是合理的。

english: A W with no M means its segmentation is unknown.
translation: 沒有 M 的 W 表示其切分未知。

english: A W with two or more Ms was segmented.
translation: 有兩個或以上 M 的 W 已經過切分。

english: A `''` that survives is a character the page shows — two apostrophes typed for a double quotation mark, as found for Seediq below. `CodeAndDocs/normalize_double_apostrophes.py` (pipeline step 6, run after `normalize_seediq_quotes.py` and before `clean_xml`) rewrites every run of exactly two apostrophes in original FORMs to `"` (380 runs in 97 articles).
translation: 保留下來的 `''` 是頁面上顯示的字元——為表示雙引號而輸入的兩個撇號，如下文賽德克語所見。`CodeAndDocs/normalize_double_apostrophes.py`（流程步驟 6，在 `normalize_seediq_quotes.py` 之後、`clean_xml` 之前執行）將原始 FORM 中每一段恰好兩個撇號的連續字元改寫為 `"`（97 篇條目中的 380 處）。

english: A `*` in any published FORM is a hard validator finding.
translation: 任何已發布 FORM 中出現 `*` 都是硬性驗證發現。

english: A `<W>` with exactly one `<M>` asserts that the word is monomorphemic, so a word gets a single `<M>` only if the source says it is monomorphemic or there is other good evidence (for example, data from the same dialect); an `<M>` is never created just so that a word has one.
translation: 只帶一個 `<M>` 的 `<W>` 表示該詞是單詞素詞，因此只有在來源說明它是單詞素，或有其他充分證據（例如來自同一方言的資料）時，詞才會只有一個 `<M>`；絕不會只為了讓詞有一個 `<M>` 而建立它。

english: A `<W>` with no `<M>` means its segmentation is unknown.
translation: 沒有 `<M>` 的 `<W>` 表示其切分情況未知。

english: A `<W>` with two or more `<M>`s was segmented.
translation: 帶有兩個或更多 `<M>` 的 `<W>` 已經過切分。

english: A `=` (clitic boundary) in a `W` FORM must also appear in at least one child `M` FORM.
translation: `W` FORM 中的 `=`（附著詞邊界）也必須出現在至少一個子 `M` FORM 中。

english: A `?` attached to a word (`LIG?`, `right?`, `clitic?`) is the author's own hedge and is kept as written.
translation: 附在詞上的 `?`（`LIG?`、`right?`、`clitic?`）是作者本人的保留語氣，照原樣保留。

english: A `?` attached to a word in a gloss (`LIG?`, `right?`) is the author's own hedge and is kept.
translation: 詞義標注中附在詞上的 `?`（`LIG?`、`right?`）是作者本人的保留語氣，予以保留。

english: A `?` inside a longer gloss (`banana-??`; 125 glosses) is left as written.
translation: 較長詞義標注內的 `?`（`banana-??`；125 個詞義標注）保留原寫法。

english: A `?` inside a longer word gloss (`banana-??`; 125 glosses, 104 distinct) is left as written unless its gloss is listed in `CodeAndDocs/unclear_gloss_placeholders.tsv`, which has no rows yet.
translation: 較長的詞的詞義標注內的 `?`（`banana-??`；125 個詞義標注，104 個不同）保留原寫法，除非其詞義標注列於 `CodeAndDocs/unclear_gloss_placeholders.tsv`，而該檔案目前尚無任何列。

english: A `?` next to an infix marker (24 `W` glosses) or attached to a word (4 glosses) is kept as written, and two sentence translations keep a `?` standing for an untranslated word.
translation: 緊鄰中綴標記的 `?`（24 個 `W` 詞義標注）或附著於詞上的 `?`（4 個詞義標注）照原樣保留，另有兩個句子翻譯保留代表未翻譯之詞的 `?`。

english: A `?` next to an infix marker (24 word glosses, e.g. `?<af>-complete`) or attached to a word (4 glosses, e.g. `decide?`) is kept as written.
translation: 緊鄰中綴標記的 `?`（24 個詞層詞義標注，例如 `?<af>-complete`）或附著於詞上的 `?`（4 個詞義標注，例如 `decide?`）照原樣保留。

english: A `?` that is one piece of a longer gloss is converted too, gloss by gloss: `CodeAndDocs/unclear_gloss_placeholders.tsv` (columns `gloss`, `lang`) lists the glosses to convert, and in each listed gloss every `?` bounded by `-`, `=`, `.`, whitespace or the ends of the string becomes `<UNCLEAR/>`:
translation: 作為較長詞義標注中一部分的 `?` 也會逐一轉換：`CodeAndDocs/unclear_gloss_placeholders.tsv`（欄位 `gloss`、`lang`）列出要轉換的詞義標注，在每個列出的詞義標注中，每個以 `-`、`=`、`.`、空白或字串兩端為界的 `?` 都會變為 `<UNCLEAR/>`：

english: A `?` that is one piece of a longer word gloss is converted too, in the 291 word glosses listed in `CodeAndDocs/unclear_gloss_placeholders.tsv` (104 distinct glosses): `?-what` becomes `<UNCLEAR/>-what`.
translation: 作為較長詞層詞義標注中一部分的 `?` 也會轉換，見於 `CodeAndDocs/unclear_gloss_placeholders.tsv` 所列的 291 個詞層詞義標注（104 個不同的詞義標注）：`?-what` 變為 `<UNCLEAR/>-what`。

english: A `Files scanned: N` line is printed to stderr.
translation: 會在 stderr 印出一行 `Files scanned: N`。

english: A `TEXT/@dialect` is missing or not canonical for its language per `dialects.csv` (`unknown` is allowed).
translation: `TEXT/@dialect` 缺少，或依 `dialects.csv` 對其語言而言不是標準值（允許 `unknown`）。

english: A `TEXT/@xml:lang` is not a known Formosan ISO 639-3 code.
translation: `TEXT/@xml:lang` 不是已知的臺灣南島語言 ISO 639-3 代碼。

english: A `TRANSL` whose entire text is `unan` is therefore not published, at any level, rather than shipped as though it meant something.
translation: 因此，全文僅為 `unan` 的 `TRANSL` 在任何層級都不發布，而不是當作有意義的內容發出。

english: A `WARNING` means "look at this," typically a stray or missing character class versus the reference; treat it as a prompt for a human to review the orthography, not a build failure.
translation: `WARNING` 的意思是「看一下這個」，通常是與參照資料相比多出或缺少某類字元；請把它當作提示人工審查書寫系統的訊號，而不是建置失敗。

english: A `W` keeps the source's angle brackets (`t<um>a-túturu`); at `M` level the infixed root is one morpheme written with a gap hyphen at the infixation point and the infix is written between hyphens — `t-a` · `-um-` · `túturu`.
translation: `W` 保留來源的尖括號（`t<um>a-túturu`）；在 `M` 層級，帶中綴的詞根是一個詞素，在中綴插入處以空位連字號書寫，而中綴則寫在兩個連字號之間——`t-a` · `-um-` · `túturu`。

english: A `W` with no `TRANSL` means the source gave no explanation for that word, not that the word is meaningless or that a gloss was lost.
translation: 沒有 `TRANSL` 的 `W` 表示來源沒有為該詞提供解說，而不是該詞沒有意義或詞義標注遺失。

english: A `languages.csv` row (ISO code + name).
translation: 一列 `languages.csv`（ISO 代碼 + 名稱）。

english: A `quote_corrections.csv` row from this step would be unexpected, since this corpus has no TRANSLs.
translation: 這一步若產生 `quote_corrections.csv` 列會出乎預期，因為本語料庫沒有 TRANSL。

english: A `standards.csv` row — leave the scheme blank until a standard is designated.
translation: 一列 `standards.csv`——在指定標準之前，方案欄位留空。

english: A `url` supplements the local or document-level reference; it does not replace these structural requirements.
translation: `url` 是本地或文件層級參照的補充；它不能取代這些結構要求。

english: A `~` between two CJK characters is not gloss notation and carries no morphological meaning.
translation: 位於兩個 CJK 字元之間的 `~` 不是詞義標注符號，也不帶有任何構詞意義。

english: A bar-marked header that is its own entry's only sense is a word the book decorated oddly rather than a bound root, and those nine are kept (`|Rariku|`, the lineage names `|Lhqapamumu|`, `|Lhqatafatu|`, `|Lhqashna'wanan|`, and five more).
translation: 若某個以豎線標示的詞頭是其詞條唯一的義項，那它是書中以特殊方式標示的詞，而非附著詞根，這九個予以保留（`|Rariku|`、氏族名 `|Lhqapamumu|`、`|Lhqatafatu|`、`|Lhqashna'wanan|`，以及另外五個）。

english: A bare grammatical label such as `(pl.)` or `(incl.)` is deliberately kept inline — it is attached to a pronoun, and "We (incl.) are early" loses its sense without it.
translation: 單純的語法標籤，如 `(pl.)` 或 `(incl.)`，刻意保留於行內——它附屬於代名詞，而 "We (incl.) are early" 少了它便失去意義。

english: A behaviour that one corpus needs, several usually need.
translation: 一個語料庫需要的行為，通常好幾個語料庫都需要。

english: A block with no translation is excluded as `missing_source_translation` (C5-001, the title `sumuladuc`).
translation: 沒有翻譯的區塊以 `missing_source_translation` 排除（C5-001，即標題 `sumuladuc`）。

english: A bracket is kept as written if it holds Chinese or Japanese characters, a word listed in `source_data/bracket_annotations.csv`, a capitalized word (a proper noun) or a number; otherwise it is classified like a slash option against the word before it, or the fragment is dropped.
translation: 若括號內含中文或日文字元、列於 `source_data/bracket_annotations.csv` 的詞、首字母大寫的詞（專有名詞）或數字，則照原樣保留；否則就把它當作斜線選項，與其前面的詞比較並分類，或捨棄該片段。

english: A build script that reads `provenance.json` to compare against, rather than hard-coding the SHA a second time, is better still.
translation: 讀取 `provenance.json` 來比較、而不是再一次寫死 SHA 的建置腳本更好。

english: A build that exits because the surrounding repository is not at the recorded commit violates this entry and POL-048, and self-invalidates the moment `main` advances. `Corpora/Song-Kanakanavu-Grammar` has the intended shape — one `git rev-parse HEAD`, one note to stderr, and the build proceeds.
translation: 因周圍儲存庫不在紀錄的提交上而結束執行的建置，違反本條目與 POL-048，而且在 `main` 前進的那一刻便自我失效。`Corpora/Song-Kanakanavu-Grammar` 具有預期的形式——一次 `git rev-parse HEAD`、一則寫到 stderr 的說明，然後建置繼續進行。

english: A candidate cleanup or review item. Reported and written to the findings CSV, but never changes the exit code.
translation: 候選的清理或審查項目。會被回報並寫入發現 CSV，但永遠不會改變結束代碼。

english: A caption that is nothing but question marks is untranscribed audio, not a sentence.
translation: 只有問號的字幕屬於未轉寫的錄音，不是句子。

english: A caption that is nothing but question marks is untranscribed audio, not a sentence: its clip is listed in the video's `_untranscribed` file and its sentence ID is retired, not reused.
translation: 只有問號的字幕屬於未轉寫的錄音，不是句子：其片段列於該影片的 `_untranscribed` 檔案中，其句子 ID 已停用，不會重複使用。

english: A change that undoes something previously ruled and merged must say so, cite the commit or POL entry it supersedes, and give the reason.
translation: 撤銷先前已裁定並合併之內容的變更，必須明說，引用其所取代的提交或 POL 條目，並說明理由。

english: A character frequency comparison was conducted between the Formosan Wikipedias and the ILRDF corpus (Indigenous Languages Research and Development Foundation).
translation: 已對臺灣南島語維基百科與 ILRDF 語料庫（Indigenous Languages Research and Development Foundation）進行字元頻率比較。

english: A character that is not clearly punctuation in a language is left everywhere in that language for now (Seediq `'`).
translation: 在某語言中不明確屬於標點的字元，目前在該語言中一律保留（賽德克語 `'`）。

english: A character that is punctuation only at the end of a word is removed only there: `.` inside Atayal `asi.ki.na` stays, and so does a Rukai `?` straight after `-` or `=`, where it marks an unknown morpheme (`pa-pacay-?`).
translation: 僅在詞尾才是標點的字元，只在詞尾移除：泰雅語 `asi.ki.na` 內的 `.` 保留，緊接在 `-` 或 `=` 之後的魯凱語 `?` 也保留，它標示未知詞素（`pa-pacay-?`）。

english: A character the table does not classify stops the build.
translation: 表中未分類的字元會使建置停止。

english: A character with no IPA value becomes `*`.
translation: 沒有 IPA 值的字元變成 `*`。

english: A checked comparison of the snapshot against the article and its errata is published at `CodeAndDocs/source_discrepancies.md`; it still lists three findings as open, but all three are now fixed in the published XML (see Known caveats above).
translation: 快照與文章及其勘誤表的核對比較發布於 `CodeAndDocs/source_discrepancies.md`；其中仍將三項發現列為未解決，但這三項在已發布的 XML 中都已修正（見上文「已知注意事項」）。

english: A checkout without git must already have that file, or the build stops.
translation: 沒有 git 的檢出副本必須已經具有該檔案，否則建置會停止。

english: A clean JSON file does not establish that it is free of earlier extraction errors.
translation: 一個乾淨的 JSON 檔案並不能證明它沒有先前的擷取錯誤。

english: A clear spelling variant — mostly overlapping letters, and the same gloss — is published as a `FORM` with `ver="alt"` sibling on the node that varies and on its word, never on the sentence.
translation: 明確的拼寫變體——字母大部分重疊，且詞義標注相同——會發布為變動節點及其所屬詞上帶有 `ver="alt"` 的同層 `FORM`，從不放在句子上。

english: A comma in a translation that the Siraya form does not have separates alternative readings, which become `ver="alt"` translations.
translation: 翻譯中出現而西拉雅語形式中沒有的逗號，用以分隔不同讀法，這些讀法成為 `ver="alt"` 翻譯。

english: A comment is a statement of intent; only the YAML is the contract.
translation: 註解是意圖的陳述；只有 YAML 才是約定。

english: A commit pin also self-invalidates: it refuses to run against the repository it lives in as soon as `main` advances.
translation: 固定提交也會自我失效：一旦 `main` 前進，它就拒絕在其所在的儲存庫上執行。

english: A compact per-rule summary (HARD then SOFT) prints to stderr, mirroring the other validators.
translation: 一份精簡的逐規則摘要（先 HARD 後 SOFT）會印到 stderr，與其他驗證器一致。

english: A competing *word* for the same meaning is not a variant: per POL-027 that becomes its own `<S>` block.
translation: 表達相同意義的另一個*詞*不是變體：依 POL-027，它會成為獨立的 `<S>` 區塊。

english: A competing lexeme for the same meaning, or a different gloss, is not a variant; per POL-027 it becomes its own `S` block, named the same way as the optional-material case below.
translation: 表達同一意義的競爭詞項，或不同的詞義標注，不是變體；依 POL-027，它會成為自己的 `S` 區塊，命名方式與下文的可選成分情況相同。

english: A comprehensive body of resources can aid educational efforts, allowing these communities to reclaim and teach their languages to younger generations, strengthening the connection between language and cultural pride.
translation: 豐富的資源體系可以協助教育工作，以促進這些族群能夠重新學習並傳授語言給年輕世代，從而強化語言與文化自豪感之間的連結。

english: A conversion table (`Orthographies/ConversionTables/<Language>_<Scheme>_113.tsv`) is a set of rules, not a sequence. `standardize.py` stages every rule through a placeholder, longest source first, so the order of rows does not matter and a rule's output is never matched by another rule.
translation: 轉換表（`Orthographies/ConversionTables/<Language>_<Scheme>_113.tsv`）是一組規則，而不是一個序列。`standardize.py` 讓每條規則都經過一個佔位符暫存，來源字串最長者優先，因此各列的順序無關緊要，且一條規則的輸出永遠不會被另一條規則匹配。

english: A corpus that is not word-segmented has no `<W>` level at all — the normal state for most of the bank, and not a finding.
translation: 沒有詞切分的語料庫完全沒有 `<W>` 層——這是本資料庫大部分內容的常態，不算是發現。

english: A corpus that repairs the original tier late must re-run steps 4 and 5 afterwards, as NTUFormosanCorpus does.
translation: 較晚才修復原始層的語料庫，之後必須重新執行步驟 4 和 5，如 NTUFormosanCorpus 的做法。

english: A corpus that skips the check states it in its `Notes and Issues` section (POL-055), because a user comparing corpora needs to know the difference between checked and clean and not checked.
translation: 略過此檢查的語料庫須在其 `Notes and Issues` 章節（POL-055）中說明，因為比較語料庫的使用者需要知道「已檢查且乾淨」與「未檢查」之間的差別。

english: A corpus whose XML changes but which ships no script that produces that XML violates POL-038.
translation: XML 有變更、卻沒有附上產生該 XML 之腳本的語料庫，違反 POL-038。

english: A corpus whose rights cannot be expressed as one of these values is not published in FormosanBank, however genuine the permission behind it.
translation: 若某語料庫的權利無法以這些值之一表示，就不會在 FormosanBank 中發布，無論其背後的許可多麼真實。

english: A corpus with no `qc_waivers.tsv` is untouched: same findings, same severities, same exit code.
translation: 沒有 `qc_waivers.tsv` 的語料庫不受影響：相同的檢查結果、相同的嚴重程度、相同的結束代碼。

english: A corpus with sub-corpora puts them above — `ePark/XML/qing_jing_zu_yu.../Saaroa/`, `NTUFormosanCorpus/XML/Stories/` — and a corpus that subdivides a language puts that below — `Safolu-Amis-Dictionary/XML/Amis/Safolu/`, `Siraya_Gospels/XML/Siraya/Matthew/`.
translation: 有子語料庫的語料庫將子語料庫放在上方——`ePark/XML/qing_jing_zu_yu.../Saaroa/`、`NTUFormosanCorpus/XML/Stories/`——而細分某個語言的語料庫則將細分放在下方——`Safolu-Amis-Dictionary/XML/Amis/Safolu/`、`Siraya_Gospels/XML/Siraya/Matthew/`。

english: A corpus without any morpheme segmentation has no `<M>` level at all.
translation: 完全沒有詞素切分的語料庫根本沒有 `<M>` 層。

english: A correction to the source
translation: 對來源的一項修正

english: A count below it is reported in `qc-summary.md`, not failed: the gate's XML-derived checks (element inventory, parentheses, hyphen-free standard tier, the unglossed morpheme) still hold the data itself, so a lower count means the validator now reports less.
translation: 數量低於已審閱數量時，會在 `qc-summary.md` 中回報，而不判為失敗：把關中由 XML 推導的檢查（元素清單、括號、無連字號的標準層、未標注詞義的詞素）仍然把守資料本身，因此數量較低表示驗證器現在回報得較少。

english: A curated reading is a decision somebody made about a page.
translation: 人工整理的讀法，是某人對某一頁做出的決定。

english: A dangling "(" closes just before the next example, or at the end of the entry.
translation: 未成對的 "(" 在下一個例句之前或詞條結尾處閉合。

english: A dataset — or a public model or Space — asserted to hold no audio, that does.
translation: 被聲明不含錄音、實際上卻含有錄音的資料集——或公開的模型或 Space。

english: A declaration is not a permanent exemption: when the file goes away, the entry must go too, or CI fails on the leftover.
translation: 宣告不是永久豁免：當檔案消失時，條目也必須一併移除，否則 CI 會因殘留的條目而失敗。

english: A derived form or an equivalent (`X - Y = Z`) gets its own entry.
translation: 衍生詞形或等義形式（`X - Y = Z`）各自成為一個詞條。

english: A detailed, generated breakdown can be found here.
translation: 詳細資訊請參見此處

english: A dev repo may keep the source's glyph (`ø`/`Ø`) while work is in progress — two 2026-08 audits chose to — but that choice does not survive publication: `clean_xml` canonicalizes the glyph the first time the corpus runs through the pipeline, so there is no per-corpus opt-out of `∅` in published data.
translation: 開發儲存庫在工作進行期間可以保留來源的字形（`ø`/`Ø`）— 2026-08 有兩次稽核選擇這麼做 — 但這個選擇不會延續到發布：語料庫第一次經過管線時，`clean_xml` 就會將該字形規範化，因此已發布資料中沒有針對個別語料庫不使用 `∅` 的選項。

english: A developer regenerates it with `python QC/validation/rules_catalogue.py`, and unlike everything above it is enforced — a test runs `--check`, so a stale catalogue is a red check rather than a silent overwrite.
translation: 開發者以 `python QC/validation/rules_catalogue.py` 重新產生它，而且與上述所有檔案不同，它受到強制檢查——有一項測試會執行 `--check`，因此過時的目錄會顯示為紅色檢查，而不是被悄悄覆寫。

english: A few of these have been removed, but most remain.
translation: 其中少數已被移除，但大多數仍保留。

english: A few sentences quote Japanese song lyrics (kana/kanji) and one sentence contains a Bopomofo fragment (`ㄇ`) from the transcriber; these are faithful to the source subtitles and are intentionally kept.
translation: 少數句子引用日語歌詞（假名／漢字），另有一個句子包含轉寫者寫下的注音符號片段（`ㄇ`）；這些都忠於來源字幕，並刻意保留。

english: A few small legacy corpora keep audio directly in Git.
translation: 少數小型的舊語料庫將錄音直接存放在 Git 中。

english: A few words list several complete alternative words separated by `/`, each itself multi-morpheme — e.g. Rukai `20200528-FW-Yongfu_S_7` `ma-lrigi/ma-elre-elrenge/ma-adraw` (smart/tall/big).
translation: 少數詞列出數個以 `/` 分隔的完整替代詞，每個本身都是多詞素 — 例如魯凱語 `20200528-FW-Yongfu_S_7` 的 `ma-lrigi/ma-elre-elrenge/ma-adraw`（smart/tall/big）。

english: A fifth, 雖然 split across `ani`/`naq` in R321, is gone: dedup merged R321 into R320 and the defective copy was the one dropped.
translation: 第五個，即 R321 中被拆在 `ani`／`naq` 上的 雖然，已經不存在：去重將 R321 併入 R320，而被刪除的正是有缺陷的那份副本。

english: A file being declared here asserts that it is already covered by its corpus's published license — if that is not true, the problem is a publication decision, and it belongs in audio publication policy and `audio_permissions.json`, not here.
translation: 在此宣告一個檔案，即是主張它已受其語料庫所發布的授權涵蓋——如果事實並非如此，問題就屬於發布決策，應歸於錄音發布政策與 `audio_permissions.json`，而不是這裡。

english: A file can be perfectly valid and still score badly there.
translation: 一個檔案可以完全有效，但在那裡仍得分很差。

english: A file can be perfectly valid and still score poorly on these.
translation: 一個檔案可以完全有效，但在這些測試上仍得分不佳。

english: A file that fails to parse is itself a HARD finding (`V000`, "XML parse error").
translation: 無法解析的檔案本身就是一筆 HARD 發現（`V000`，「XML parse error」）。

english: A file that fails to parse prints a warning to stderr and is skipped (it does not emit a `V000` finding the way `validate_xml.py`/`validate_text.py` do).
translation: 無法解析的檔案會在 stderr 印出警告並被略過（它不會像 `validate_xml.py`/`validate_text.py` 那樣產生 `V000` 檢查結果）。

english: A flat table cannot express "palatalized before i".
translation: 單純的對照表無法表達「在 i 之前顎化」。

english: A folder of links to every other corpus in the checkout is made so `validate_xml.py` can check that no `TEXT` id collides with another corpus.
translation: 建立一個連結到工作副本中所有其他語料庫的資料夾，讓 `validate_xml.py` 能檢查沒有任何 `TEXT` id 與其他語料庫衝突。

english: A form with notes of its own, such as a borrowing marker, is not merged.
translation: 本身帶有註記（例如借詞標記）的形式不予合併。

english: A fourth item that the old corpus page listed among these notes records a FormosanBank import decision rather than Akiw's observations:
translation: 舊語料庫頁面在這些筆記中列出的第四項，記錄的是 FormosanBank 的匯入決定，而不是 Akiw 的觀察：

english: A free translation written as two renderings, `A / B` ("I have three younger brothers. / There are my three younger brothers."), is published as a translation plus an alternative translation (`ver="alt"`): 48 Sentences translations (`pipeline/split_two_renderings.py`; ruling 2026-10-16).
translation: 寫成兩種譯法的自由翻譯 `A / B`（"I have three younger brothers. / There are my three younger brothers."）發布為一個翻譯加一個替代翻譯（`ver="alt"`）：48 個 Sentences 翻譯（`pipeline/split_two_renderings.py`；2026-10-16 裁定）。

english: A fresh staging directory `CodeAndDocs/.build.XXXXXX` is created (and deleted on exit), and the committed inputs are copied into it: `scripts/`, `data/manual/` (`manual_sentences.xml`, `source_additions.csv`, `clitic_merges.tsv`), six files from `data/processed/` (`quality_filtered_examples.jsonl`, `examples_raw.jsonl`, `examples_clean.jsonl`, `gloss_records.jsonl`, `duplicates.csv`, `source_metadata.csv`) and `manual_edits.xml`.
translation: 建立一個全新的暫存目錄 `CodeAndDocs/.build.XXXXXX`（並在結束時刪除），並將已提交的輸入複製進去：`scripts/`、`data/manual/`（`manual_sentences.xml`、`source_additions.csv`、`clitic_merges.tsv`）、`data/processed/` 中的六個檔案（`quality_filtered_examples.jsonl`、`examples_raw.jsonl`、`examples_clean.jsonl`、`gloss_records.jsonl`、`duplicates.csv`、`source_metadata.csv`）以及 `manual_edits.xml`。

english: A further 1,244 standard-tier FORMs render differently once re-standardized, mostly the same corpora.
translation: 另有 1,244 個標準層 FORM 在重新標準化後會呈現不同，大多是同樣的語料庫。

english: A further class of repair sits behind that number.
translation: 這個數字背後還有另一類修復。

english: A further small set has the Chinese gloss available in a duplicate of the same word elsewhere in the source, repairable on request.
translation: 另有一小部分在來源中其他地方同一詞的重複出現中有中文詞義標注，可應要求修復。

english: A genuine alternation has `/` between forms, never at the end, so real `a/b` forms (step 16) are untouched.
translation: 真正的替代在形式之間有 `/`，從不在結尾，因此真正的 `a/b` 形式（步驟 16）不受影響。

english: A genuine one-off editorial judgement goes in `manual_edits.xml`, the standard FormosanBank mechanism, replayed by `apply_manual_edits.py` and summarised in `manual_edits.md`.
translation: 真正一次性的編輯判斷放在 `manual_edits.xml` 中，這是 FormosanBank 的標準機制，由 `apply_manual_edits.py` 重播，並摘要於 `manual_edits.md`。

english: A git-tracked file sits under a `Private/` directory. `Private/` holds development-only material (keys, notes, restricted source data) that must never ship; a tracked file there would be published by the next push.
translation: 有受 git 追蹤的檔案位於 `Private/` 目錄下。`Private/` 存放僅供開發使用的資料（金鑰、筆記、受限的來源資料），絕不能發出；其中受追蹤的檔案會在下一次推送時被發布。

english: A gloss from another post is never reused, because there is no guarantee it is contextually right.
translation: 絕不重複使用其他文章的詞義標注，因為無法保證它在上下文中正確。

english: A gloss label in a word's form: Kanakanavu Sentences `3_S_456`, where NTU typed `AV.` (the gloss) into the form column, `AV.kara-peen=kasu`.
translation: 詞形中的詞義標注標籤：卡那卡那富語 Sentences `3_S_456`，NTU 將 `AV.`（詞義標注）打進了形式欄，`AV.kara-peen=kasu`。

english: A gloss that reads `"bring, AV. The root is kacu 'bring'."` stays exactly as the source wrote it.
translation: 讀作 `"bring, AV. The root is kacu 'bring'."` 的詞義標注完全保持來源所寫的樣子。

english: A gloss that was only a marker becomes a properly empty TRANSL.
translation: 只含標記的詞義標注會成為正確的空 TRANSL。

english: A glossed optional morpheme or clitic (`kangavas(=an)` 'mango(=MED.NOM)') is different (POL-028 as amended 2026-10-15): the two readings are glossed differently, so each is a sentence of its own with its own word and morpheme tiers — the base keeps the published id, the other reading is `<id>-opt`.
translation: 帶詞義標注的可選詞素或附著詞（`kangavas(=an)` 'mango(=MED.NOM)'）則不同（依 2026-10-15 修訂的 POL-028）：兩種讀法的詞義標注不同，因此各自成為一個句子，具有自己的詞層與詞素層——基本讀法保留已發布的 id，另一讀法為 `<id>-opt`。

english: A good place to start is the overview page.
translation: 概覽頁面是很好的起點。

english: A group of several blocks becomes one record under the first block's id, with the Seediq, glosses and translations joined and a note naming the blocks; the later blocks stay as `exclude` rows with reason `merged_into_<id>` (C5-009 into C5-008, C5-030 into C5-029).
translation: 由多個區塊組成的一組會成為一筆紀錄，使用第一個區塊的 id，其賽德克語、詞義標注與翻譯會合併，並附上列出各區塊的附註；後續區塊保留為 `exclude` 列，原因為 `merged_into_<id>`（C5-009 併入 C5-008，C5-030 併入 C5-029）。

english: A group with no reference prints `SUMMARY orthography | <group> | reference=missing | warnings=1`.
translation: 沒有參照資料的群組會印出 `SUMMARY orthography | <group> | reference=missing | warnings=1`。

english: A group with no reference prints `SUMMARY vocabulary | <group> | reference=missing | warnings=1`.
translation: 沒有參照資料的群組會印出 `SUMMARY vocabulary | <group> | reference=missing | warnings=1`。

english: A handful of sentences contain Chinese words code-switched into the Yami text; they are transcribed as printed.
translation: 少數句子含有以語碼轉換方式夾入雅美語文本的中文詞；這些照印刷原樣轉寫。

english: A handful of sentences need a correction that the blanket pipeline cannot make on its own.
translation: 有少數句子需要的更正是全面性管線無法自行完成的。

english: A handful of sentences need a correction the blanket pipeline cannot make on its own.
translation: 有少數句子需要的更正是全面性管線無法自行完成的。

english: A head word and each form listed with it (derived forms, `=` equivalents, and pairs of forms printed with one shared definition) are separate entries with the same translation.
translation: 詞目以及與其一同列出的每個形式（衍生形式、`=` 同義形式，以及共用同一釋義印出的成對形式）都是各自獨立的詞條，具有相同的翻譯。

english: A headword differs in one respect: a slash between whole headwords is two entries (or one entry with a spelling variant), never "not confident", and a spaced trailing bracket that is not annotation is read as a second form.
translation: 詞目有一點不同：整個詞目之間的斜線表示兩個條目（或一個帶拼寫變體的條目），絕不算「沒有把握」；而結尾處前有空格、且不是註解的括號，則讀作第二個形式。

english: A high-resolution reading of the scan suggests the mark is a caron, matching the `ř` elsewhere on the same line, but a single glyph on a 1962 mimeograph is not enough evidence to change a published letter, so it stands.
translation: 以高解析度判讀掃描檔顯示該符號是抑揚符（caron），與同一行其他地方的 `ř` 相符，但 1962 年油印本上的單一字形不足以作為更改已發布字母的證據，因此維持現狀。

english: A hyphen is a segmentation marker rather than a letter of the standard orthography, so the blanket pipeline strips it and the decision table does not put it back. `V133` (`dash_in_S_standard_FORM`) therefore does not fire at all, and `normalize_sentence_standards.py` rejects any decision row that would reintroduce a hyphen.
translation: 連字號是切分標記，而不是標準書寫系統的字母，因此全面性的流程會將它去除，而決策表不會把它加回去。`V133`（`dash_in_S_standard_FORM`）因此完全不會觸發，且 `normalize_sentence_standards.py` 會拒絕任何會重新加入連字號的決策列。

english: A hyphen is a segmentation marker rather than a letter of the standard orthography, so the pipeline strips it and the decision table does not put it back. `V133` (`dash_in_S_standard_FORM`) does not fire at all.
translation: 連字號是切分標記，而不是標準書寫系統的字母，因此流程會將它去除，而決策表不會把它加回去。`V133`（`dash_in_S_standard_FORM`）完全不會觸發。

english: A known printing error is left as printed: the translation of 1c (p. 78, `yaku-naq (ka) pure ido`) reads 煮飯的的人是我自己, with 的 doubled; its `notes` says so.
translation: 一處已知的印刷錯誤照印刷保留：1c（第 78 頁，`yaku-naq (ka) pure ido`）的翻譯為 煮飯的的人是我自己，其中「的」重複；其 `notes` 有說明。

english: A language folder per language (e.g. `Amis/`).
translation: 每個語言一個語言資料夾（例如 `Amis/`）。

english: A language with no standard orthography gets no orthography check.
translation: 沒有標準書寫系統的語言不進行書寫系統檢查。

english: A language-named directory is common, but it is not a schema requirement.
translation: 以語言命名的目錄很常見，但並非綱要（schema）的要求。

english: A legitimate change lands by explicit maintainer override, which is deliberately the hardest step in the mechanism.
translation: 正當的變更須經維護者明確覆寫才能合併，這刻意被設計為整個機制中最困難的一步。

english: A letter-to-letter conversion row would assert a correspondence that does not exist, so there is none.
translation: 逐字母的轉換列會主張一個並不存在的對應，因此沒有設這樣的列。

english: A licensing and consent record.
translation: 一份授權與同意的記錄。

english: A listed gloss that no longer matches the snapshot, a listed file that does not exist, or a count other than five applied is a hard error.
translation: 若所列的詞義標注不再與快照相符、所列的檔案不存在，或套用的數量不是五個，即為嚴重錯誤。

english: A maintainer reads the table to catch distribution problems that no hard rule can express — too many `unknown` files in one language, a dialect that leaked into the wrong language, or far fewer files for a dialect than expected.
translation: 維護者閱讀此表，以發現任何硬性規則都無法表達的分布問題——某一語言中有太多 `unknown` 檔案、某個方言誤混入錯誤的語言，或某方言的檔案數遠少於預期。

english: A merged decision is reversed explicitly or not at all.
translation: 已合併的決定要嘛明確推翻，要嘛完全不推翻。

english: A minimal text file has a `<TEXT>` root, required source metadata, and at least one sentence:
translation: 一個最精簡的文本檔案具有 `<TEXT>` 根元素、必要的來源後設資料，以及至少一個句子：

english: A misnamed sidecar is silently ignored rather than reported.
translation: 命名錯誤的附屬檔會被無聲地忽略，而不會被回報。

english: A missing FORM means that no transcription is available; `<UNCLEAR/>` records that transcription was attempted but the content could not be recovered.
translation: 缺少 FORM 表示沒有可用的轉寫；`<UNCLEAR/>` 則記錄曾嘗試轉寫但內容無法還原。

english: A missing WAV, a bad time or an empty stretch is reported and skipped.
translation: 缺少 WAV、時間錯誤或區段為空時，會回報並略過。

english: A missing sidecar is not an error; it means "no conditioned rules for this scheme," which is correct for most of them and indistinguishable from a typo'd filename.
translation: 缺少附屬檔並不是錯誤；它代表「此方案沒有條件式規則」，這對大多數方案而言是正確的，但與檔名打錯字的情況無法區分。

english: A morpheme has a form and a position and nothing else.
translation: 一個詞素只有形式和位置，別無其他。

english: A morpheme the transcriber could not write: in five Rukai words NTU wrote `?` for it; the `?` is `<UNCLEAR/>` in their word and morpheme FORMs and, where it appears, the sentence FORM (`alupu-?=ini` → `alupu-<UNCLEAR/>=ini`, `?la-lasu` → `<UNCLEAR/>la-lasu`; ruling 2026-10-18: "Yes: for the ? piece").
translation: 轉寫者無法寫出的詞素：在五個魯凱語詞中，NTU 以 `?` 表示該詞素；該 `?` 在其詞與詞素 FORM 中，以及出現之處的句子 FORM 中，都是 `<UNCLEAR/>`（`alupu-?=ini` → `alupu-<UNCLEAR/>=ini`、`?la-lasu` → `<UNCLEAR/>la-lasu`；2026-10-18 裁定：「是：針對 ? 那一部分」）。

english: A multi-word gloss printed over a span gets sliced word-by-word:
translation: 印在一段範圍上方的多詞詞義標注會被逐詞切開：

english: A name that a 2024 file with different content already has is never reused: the new recording takes `_2` (`Amis_137_2.mp3`), as the Yami same-village names do.
translation: 已被內容不同的 2024 年檔案使用的名稱絕不重複使用：新錄音加上 `_2`（`Amis_137_2.mp3`），與雅美語同村落錄音的命名方式相同。

english: A note on segmentation notation: Li's interlinear markers (`-` and `=` for morpheme/clitic boundaries, `<...>` for infixes) are preserved in the `original` tier and in the word/morpheme tiers, where they carry the morphological analysis.
translation: 關於切分記法的說明：Li 的逐行對照標記（`-` 與 `=` 表示詞素／附著詞邊界，`<...>` 表示中綴）保留在 `original` 層以及詞／詞素層中，在那裡承載形態分析。

english: A null in a W FORM requires a null M child (V069 HARD).
translation: W FORM 中的零形式需要一個零 M 子元素（V069 HARD）。

english: A one-letter word alternating `a`/`u` (WakelinTexts `Kwaway/S2W3`) is as valid a variant as a letter changing inside a longer word.
translation: 一個在 `a`/`u` 之間交替的單字母詞（WakelinTexts `Kwaway/S2W3`），和較長詞內部的一個字母改變一樣，都是有效的變體。

english: A one-off editorial judgement goes in `manual_edits.xml` — see "Recorded hand edits" above.
translation: 一次性的編輯判斷放在 `manual_edits.xml` 中——見上文「記錄的人工編輯」。

english: A page belongs in this section when all three are true: there is a file in the repository that records the rule; there is an automated check that enforces it; and getting it wrong fails somewhere other than where you made the mistake.
translation: 當以下三點皆成立時，頁面就屬於本節：儲存庫中有一個記錄該規則的檔案；有一個強制執行它的自動檢查；而且弄錯時，失敗發生在您犯錯之處以外的地方。

english: A parent may have at most one PHON for each `kindOf` value.
translation: 每個父元素對每個 `kindOf` 值最多只能有一個 PHON。

english: A parenthesis counts as a gloss only if it contains a Chinese character and no Latin letter.
translation: 括號只有在包含漢字且不含拉丁字母時，才算是詞義標注。

english: A parenthetical that pairs with one in the Thao — the two sides carry the same number, so they are about the same thing — belongs to the example and is expanded in step with it.
translation: 與邵語中某個括號內容配對的括號內容——兩側帶有相同編號，因此談的是同一件事——屬於例句的一部分，並與其同步展開。

english: A parse failure is itself a HARD `V000` finding.
translation: 解析失敗本身就是一個 HARD `V000` 檢查結果。

english: A part-of-speech label standing in for a word
translation: 以詞性標籤取代了詞

english: A pipe hides an exit code.
translation: 管線會隱藏結束代碼。

english: A pipeline's exit status is its last command's, so the step reported `tee`'s `0` and the gate never fired.
translation: 管線的結束狀態取決於最後一個指令，因此該步驟回報的是 `tee` 的 `0`，關卡從未觸發。

english: A place name welded on without its parentheses
translation: 地名黏接上去，缺少其括號

english: A populated `standard` tier is assumed for the default `--tier standard`; if a corpus has only an original tier, either pass `--tier original` or create the standard tier first with standardize.py `--copy`.
translation: 預設的 `--tier standard` 假設已有填入內容的 `standard` 層；若語料庫只有原始層，請傳入 `--tier original`，或先用 standardize.py `--copy` 建立標準層。

english: A printing error left as printed.
translation: 一處照印刷保留的印刷錯誤。

english: A pronoun inside such a pair is written as an infix.
translation: 這類詞對中間的代名詞寫成中綴。

english: A pronoun printed inside such a pair (`ani-ku naq`) is written as an infix, `ani<ku>naq` 雖然.
translation: 印在這類詞對中間的代名詞（`ani-ku naq`）寫成中綴：`ani<ku>naq` 雖然。

english: A publication build reads one exact commit of the public FormosanBank XML and creates an indexed SQLite read model, small catalogues, checksums, and prepared downloads.
translation: 發布建置會讀取公開 FormosanBank XML 的某一個確切提交（commit），並建立有索引的 SQLite 讀取模型、小型目錄、校驗碼及預先準備的下載檔。

english: A published corpus rebuilds from a FormosanBank checkout alone.
translation: 已發布的語料庫僅憑一份 FormosanBank 檢出即可重建。

english: A published corpus rebuilds from a FormosanBank checkout alone. Dev repos are permanently private and are never a build input.
translation: 已發布的語料庫僅憑一份 FormosanBank 檢出（checkout）即可重建。開發儲存庫永久不公開，也從不作為建置輸入。

english: A pull request that ports or reworks one corpus does not change shared code.
translation: 移植或重做單一語料庫的合併請求（pull request）不變更共用程式碼。

english: A reading already emitted for that language is skipped; every reading after the first in a language, and every column 2 reading, gets `ver="alt"`.
translation: 該語言已輸出過的讀法會略過；某語言中第一個之後的每個讀法，以及每個第 2 欄讀法，都會加上 `ver="alt"`。

english: A reading identical to an earlier example is published once.
translation: 與先前例句相同的讀法只發布一次。

english: A reading that replaces a whole word rather than one morpheme inside it inherits no morphemes.
translation: 取代整個詞而非其中某個詞素的讀法不繼承任何詞素。

english: A reading that replaces a whole word rather than one morpheme inside it inherits no morphemes: `Kalaku1/S6b`'s `namen-em` gets none, because the source's `ngaran` and `amn` are not in it.
translation: 取代整個詞而非其中某個詞素的讀法不繼承任何詞素：`Kalaku1/S6b` 的 `namen-em` 沒有詞素，因為來源的 `ngaran` 與 `amn` 不在其中。

english: A real fix must thread segmentation information through to phonology generation where it exists, and accept the ambiguity where it doesn't.
translation: 真正的修正必須在有切分資訊之處將其一路傳遞到音韻產生階段，並在沒有之處接受其歧義。

english: A real schema/structure violation. Drives the exit code — any HARD finding exits `1` (CI-gating).
translation: 真正的結構定義／結構違規。決定結束代碼——任何 HARD 發現都會以 `1` 結束（CI 把關）。

english: A reason is mandatory.
translation: 理由為必填。

english: A rebuild that leaves the old commit in place is a stale record, which is worse than none — it asserts a correspondence between the tools and the bytes that no longer holds.
translation: 留下舊提交的重建是過時的紀錄，比沒有紀錄更糟——它斷言工具與位元組之間存在一種已不再成立的對應關係。

english: A record holding several sentences is cut into fragments: numbered examples `1.` `2.`…, a slash after sentence-final punctuation, or `(a) / (b)`.
translation: 含有多個句子的記錄會被切成片段：編號例句 `1.` `2.`…、句末標點後的斜線，或 `(a) / (b)`。

english: A record split into several `S` keeps its id on the first and adds `-opt`, `-opt3` … to the others (POL-028).
translation: 拆分為多個 `S` 的記錄，第一個保留其 id，其餘加上 `-opt`、`-opt3` …（POL-028）。

english: A record split into several `S` keeps its id on the first and adds `-opt`, `-opt3` … to the others.
translation: 拆分為多個 `S` 的記錄，第一個保留其 id，其餘加上 `-opt`、`-opt3` …。

english: A record the ledger matches keeps the 2024 id; 2024 duplicates merged into it add their distinct translations; a ledger row `withdrawn` is published from the 2024 snapshot with the `S/@source` above.
translation: 對照表比對到的記錄保留 2024 年的 id；合併到其中的 2024 年重複記錄會加入它們各自不同的翻譯；標記為 `withdrawn` 的對照表列則從 2024 年快照發布，並帶有上述的 `S/@source`。

english: A record with no readable fragment is deleted.
translation: 沒有任何可讀片段的記錄會被刪除。

english: A related consequence: `validate_glosses` also raises 274 SOFT V062, asking that a word containing an infix carry angle-bracket (`<AV>`-style) notation in its `TRANSL`.
translation: 相關的結果是：`validate_glosses` 也提出 274 個 SOFT V062，要求含中綴的詞在其 `TRANSL` 中帶有角括號（`<AV>` 式）標記法。

english: A renamed file
translation: 一個重新命名的檔案

english: A reproducibility record.
translation: 一份可重現性的記錄。

english: A reviewer checks them against the book in a web page, and three scripts carry the corrections back reproducibly:
translation: 審閱者在一個網頁中對照原書檢查它們，再由三個腳本以可重現的方式將修正帶回：

english: A reviewer who doubts a claim escalates to the maintainer; only a positive finding — the source says otherwise, or the grant is known not to exist — justifies a change.
translation: 對某項主張有疑慮的審查者應上報維護者；只有正面的發現——來源另有說明，或已知授權並不存在——才足以支持變更。

english: A rewritten original FORM gets `notes="source: <the source text>"`.
translation: 被改寫的原始 FORM 會加上 `notes="source: <the source text>"`。

english: A root that has no translated entry of its own anywhere in the book gets no entry (it may be a bound root).
translation: 在全書任何地方都沒有自己的已翻譯詞條的詞根，不會成為詞條（它可能是黏著詞根）。

english: A row runs down to the next start.
translation: 一列向下延伸至下一個起始點。

english: A row starts at a column-1 line that begins at the same height as, or just above, the first line of cells in columns 2–5; starts closer than 20 points are merged.
translation: 一列始於第 1 欄中的一行，該行的起始高度與第 2–5 欄第一行儲存格相同或略高；相距不到 20 點的起始點會合併。

english: A row whose conversion already gives the target spelling also fails the build, as a no-op.
translation: 若某列經轉換後已經得到目標拼寫，也會被視為無作用而使建置失敗。

english: A rule now covers it.
translation: 現在已有規則涵蓋它。

english: A run of Bunun `63` records ends a word with a slash and an empty second alternative — `bunbun?/`, `ha?/`, `mai-babu=tan?/` — where the `?` is sentence-final punctuation kept on the last word and the `/` is a transcription artifact, not an alternation (the matching glosses carry no slash; the S-level FORM never has the stray slash).
translation: 一系列布農語 `63` 記錄在詞尾帶有斜線及空的第二個替代形式 — `bunbun?/`、`ha?/`、`mai-babu=tan?/` — 其中 `?` 是保留在最後一個詞上的句末標點，而 `/` 是轉寫產物，並非替代（對應的詞義標注沒有斜線；S 層級 FORM 從未帶有該零星斜線）。

english: A run of three or more question marks inside a caption becomes an `<UNCLEAR/>` element.
translation: 字幕中連續三個或更多問號會成為 `<UNCLEAR/>` 元素。

english: A search can start with a Formosan expression or with a translation.
translation: 搜尋可以從臺灣南島語的語句開始，也可以從翻譯開始。

english: A second Sakizaya record fixes `Luxembourg` (see "Apostrophe handling").
translation: 第二筆撒奇萊雅語記錄修正 `Luxembourg`（見「撇號處理」）。

english: A second XML with the postfix `_untranscribed` has no `<S>` elements and references the remaining audio.
translation: 第二個帶有後綴 `_untranscribed` 的 XML 沒有 `<S>` 元素，並參照其餘的錄音。

english: A second `clean_xml` pass strips `-` from the standard tier where the orthography doesn't use it as a letter (kept for Bunun/Thao per C012) and normalizes smart quotes `’→'` in both FORM tiers (otherwise validate_text flags V110/V127/V133):
translation: 第二次 `clean_xml` 執行會在書寫系統不將 `-` 當作字母使用之處，從標準層中刪除 `-`（依 C012，布農語／邵語保留），並在兩個 FORM 層中將智慧引號 `’→'` 正規化（否則 validate_text 會標記 V110/V127/V133）：

english: A second build must reproduce the same XML.
translation: 第二次建置必須重現相同的 XML。

english: A second, smaller correction: `Kwaway/S9`'s gloss `bamboo-strips` is written `bamboo.strips`.
translation: 第二項較小的修正：`Kwaway/S9` 的詞義標注 `bamboo-strips` 寫作 `bamboo.strips`。

english: A second, smaller correction: `Kwaway/S9`'s gloss is written `bamboo.strips`, not `bamboo-strips`.
translation: 第二項較小的修正：`Kwaway/S9` 的詞義標注寫作 `bamboo.strips`，而不是 `bamboo-strips`。

english: A segment that is nothing but such a reference stays as text.
translation: 若一個片段完全只是這類參照，則保留為文字。

english: A selection can include one Formosan language, optional corpus and dialect filters, Formosan or translation matching, evidence requirements, and explicitly chosen fields.
translation: 一次選取可包含一種臺灣南島語、選用的語料庫與方言篩選條件、以臺灣南島語或翻譯進行比對、證據要求，以及明確選擇的欄位。

english: A sense's part of speech rides on that sense's `TRANSL/@notes`.
translation: 義項的詞性記錄在該義項的 `TRANSL/@notes` 上。

english: A sentence "carries some parsing" when either (a) some W in it has two or more M children, or (b) some M's FORM differs from its parent W's FORM (an infix split, or an M that shows a segmentation the W FORM does not).
translation: 句子「帶有部分剖析」是指：(a) 其中某個 W 有兩個或以上的 M 子元素，或 (b) 某個 M 的 FORM 與其父 W 的 FORM 不同（中綴拆分，或 M 顯示出 W FORM 未顯示的切分）。

english: A sentence counts as analysed if some word has two or more `M`, or some `M`'s FORM differs from its word's FORM.
translation: 若某個詞有兩個或更多 `M`，或某個 `M` 的 FORM 與其所屬詞的 FORM 不同，該句子即視為已分析。

english: A sentence counts as parsed when any of its words contains a hyphen; in a parsed sentence every word gets M elements, split on `-`, each paired with the matching piece of the word's gloss.
translation: 句子中任一詞含有連字號即視為已剖析；在已剖析的句子中，每個詞都依 `-` 分割取得 M 元素，每個 M 與該詞詞義標注的對應片段配對。

english: A sentence ends where the next caption begins, including a caption with no text: so a video's last sentence ends with its caption rather than running to the end of the video, and stretches covered by no caption are untranscribed audio, listed in the video's `_untranscribed` file.
translation: 一個句子在下一則字幕開始處結束，包括沒有文字的字幕：因此影片的最後一句在其字幕結束時結束，而不是延續到影片結尾；沒有任何字幕涵蓋的片段屬於未轉寫的錄音，列於該影片的 `_untranscribed` 檔案中。

english: A sentence for which no alignment passes the gloss checks gets no analysis.
translation: 沒有任何對齊方式通過詞義標注檢查的句子不會得到分析。

english: A sentence is expanded only when all hold: exactly one word has `/` in its FORM and is `<M>`-segmented; every morpheme's FORM/PHON tiers and glosses split into 1 (shared) or the same N≥2 (alternation); the word-level FORM splits into exactly N (this rejects word-level alternation the parser mis-segmented at the morpheme tier — see below); each morpheme group occurs verbatim in the word- and sentence-level FORM/PHON; and the free translation has no `/`.
translation: 只有在以下條件全部成立時，句子才會被展開：恰好一個詞的 FORM 含有 `/` 且有 `<M>` 切分；每個詞素的 FORM/PHON 層與詞義標注拆分為 1 個（共用）或相同的 N≥2 個（替代）；詞層級 FORM 恰好拆分為 N 個（這會排除剖析器在詞素層誤切分的詞層級替代 — 見下文）；每個詞素組逐字出現在詞層級與句子層級的 FORM/PHON 中；且自由翻譯沒有 `/`。

english: A sentence is split only when all hold: (1) its FORM has a parenthesis; (2) its free translation has none; (3) every parenthesis-bearing word is a whole parenthetical (FORM matches `^\([^()]*\)$`, so no parens are embedded in or split across other words); (4) each such word's gloss is itself fully parenthesized.
translation: 只有在以下條件全部成立時，句子才會被拆分：(1) 其 FORM 含有括號；(2) 其自由翻譯沒有括號；(3) 每個帶括號的詞都是完整的括號內容（FORM 符合 `^\([^()]*\)$`，因此沒有括號嵌入其他詞中或跨詞拆開）；(4) 每個這種詞的詞義標注本身也完全加上括號。

english: A sentence may have several English or Chinese translations.
translation: 某些句子常會有多種不同的翻譯

english: A sentence named in `source_data/alternative_rulings.json` is replaced by exactly the `S` records the ruling lists (it stops if a ruling finds no record).
translation: 列於 `source_data/alternative_rulings.json` 的句子，由該裁定所列的 `S` 記錄完全取代（若某裁定找不到記錄便停止）。

english: A sentence that carries no parsing carries no M at all — the author may simply never have analyzed it, and requiring an M there would fake an analysis it does not have.
translation: 不帶任何剖析的句子完全沒有 M — 作者可能根本沒有分析過它，若要求該處有 M，就是偽造一個它並不具有的分析。

english: A sentence translation that is wholly unknown is not emitted (no TRANSL); a word or morpheme gloss that is wholly unknown is `<TRANSL><UNCLEAR/></TRANSL>`.
translation: 完全未知的句子翻譯不會輸出（沒有 TRANSL）；完全未知的詞或詞素詞義標注則為 `<TRANSL><UNCLEAR/></TRANSL>`。

english: A sentence whose caption had parentheses gets the FORM note `multiple speakers`.
translation: 字幕中有括號的句子會得到 FORM 注記 `multiple speakers`。

english: A sentence whose translation is a placeholder is set aside and published only if the frozen id ledger claims it.
translation: 翻譯為佔位符的句子會先擱置，只有在凍結的 id 對照表認領它時才發布。

english: A sentence with `S/@source` (a 2024-only sentence) is left untouched.
translation: 帶有 `S/@source` 的句子（僅存在於 2024 年的句子）保持不動。

english: A sentence with k different recordings becomes k `S` with the same text and translations (15,599 added `S`).
translation: 有 k 個不同錄音的句子會成為 k 個文字與翻譯都相同的 `S`（新增 15,599 個 `S`）。

english: A sentence with k different recordings becomes k `S` with the same text and translations: the first keeps the id, the others take `-opt`, `-opt3` … (15,599 added `S`: 8,808 `-opt`, 6,326 `-opt3`, 465 `-opt4` or higher).
translation: 有 k 個不同錄音的句子會成為 k 個文字與翻譯都相同的 `S`：第一個保留原 id，其餘依序使用 `-opt`、`-opt3` ……（新增 15,599 個 `S`：8,808 個 `-opt`、6,326 個 `-opt3`、465 個 `-opt4` 或更高）。

english: A sentence with no W announces nothing at all: there is no per-sentence signal that distinguishes "not segmented yet" from "not segmented, by design".
translation: 沒有 W 的句子則完全不顯示任何訊號：沒有任何逐句的訊號能區分「尚未切分」與「刻意不切分」。

english: A sentence with no letter or digit, or whose text is a placeholder (`-`, `---`), is skipped.
translation: 沒有任何字母或數字、或文字為佔位符（`-`、`---`）的句子會被略過。

english: A sentence with several different recordings is also split this way, one `S` per recording (see "Recordings" below); those 15,599 added ids are listed in CodeAndDocs/docs/recording_split_ids.csv.
translation: 有多段不同錄音的句子也以此方式拆分，每段錄音一個 `S`（見下方「錄音」）；這些新增的 15,599 個 id 列於 CodeAndDocs/docs/recording_split_ids.csv。

english: A sentence's audio starts at its caption's timestamp and ends at the next caption's timestamp; a video's last sentence gets no end time (it runs to the end of the video) unless the table below gives one, which leaves 16 sentences in the published XML without an end time.
translation: 句子的錄音從其字幕的時間戳記開始，到下一則字幕的時間戳記結束；影片的最後一句沒有結束時間（延續到影片結尾），除非下表提供了結束時間，因此已發布的 XML 中有 16 個句子沒有結束時間。

english: A sentence-initial capital `G` is ng too, so S3846 reads `Nga'ayto` and S4934 `Nga'ayho` in both tiers (maintainer ruling 2026-10-17).
translation: 句首大寫 `G` 也代表 ng，因此 S3846 在兩個層中都讀作 `Nga'ayto`，S4934 讀作 `Nga'ayho`（維護者裁定 2026-10-17）。

english: A sentence-level alternate for a one-morpheme spelling difference is noise, and where one sentence carries two independent alternations (`Kalaku1/S17`) it is worse than noise: it can only show one of them, which reads as a claim that the other did not vary.
translation: 針對單一詞素拼寫差異的句子層級替代形式是雜訊，而當一個句子帶有兩個獨立的交替形式時（`Kalaku1/S17`），情況比雜訊更糟：它只能顯示其中一個，讀起來就像在主張另一個沒有變動。

english: A separate suite in CodeAndDocs/qa/ measures how well it holds together as a glossed corpus — whether the word tier accounts for the sentence, whether every morpheme a form implies has an `M`, whether the glosses sit in the right language slots.
translation: CodeAndDocs/qa/ 中另有一套測試，衡量它作為詞義標注語料庫的整體一致性——詞層是否能對應句子、形式所隱含的每個詞素是否都有 `M`、詞義標注是否位於正確的語言欄位。

english: A shell accumulator — `xml-validation` and `audio-validation` loop over changed files, set `fail=1`, and `exit $fail` at the end, so one bad file doesn't hide the rest.
translation: Shell 累加器——`xml-validation` 與 `audio-validation` 逐一處理變更的檔案，設定 `fail=1`，並在最後執行 `exit $fail`，如此一個有問題的檔案就不會掩蓋其他檔案。

english: A shell loop deletes each of the five language folders under `XML/` and copies the snapshot's folder of the same name in its place.
translation: 一個 shell 迴圈刪除 `XML/` 下的五個語言資料夾，並把快照中同名的資料夾複製到原處。

english: A short summary prints to stdout, e.g. the count of HARD and SOFT groups and their occurrence totals, followed by the findings CSV path.
translation: stdout 會印出簡短摘要，例如 HARD 與 SOFT 群組的數量及其出現次數總計，接著是檢查結果 CSV 的路徑。

english: A sidecar may carry an optional fourth `dialect` column, currently used by `Ortho113/Seediq.rules.tsv` and `Ortho113/Bunun.rules.tsv`.
translation: 附屬檔可帶有選用的第四欄 `dialect`，目前由 `Ortho113/Seediq.rules.tsv` 與 `Ortho113/Bunun.rules.tsv` 使用。

english: A significant reason to study Formosan languages lies in their ability to challenge and potentially reshape established linguistic theories.
translation: 研究臺灣南島語的重要原因之一，在於其可能挑戰並重塑既有的語言學理論的能力。

english: A single cautious judgement propagates to every `TEXT` in the corpus — 100 files for #167, 16 for #179 — and is expensive to reverse.
translation: 一次謹慎的判斷會擴及語料庫中的每個 `TEXT`——#167 為 100 個檔案，#179 為 16 個——而且撤回代價高昂。

english: A slash alternates one word with one word: `laqi/heya`, `ini/uxe`.
translation: 斜線以一個詞替換一個詞：`laqi/heya`、`ini/uxe`。

english: A sleeping service may take time to start, and model output is an unreviewed draft rather than an authoritative translation or correction.
translation: 處於休眠狀態的服務可能需要一些時間才能啟動，而模型輸出是未經審閱的草稿，並非具權威性的翻譯或校正。

english: A small number of source defects survive.
translation: 少數來源缺陷仍然存在。

english: A small residue survives: 28 free translations still carry a parenthetical inline (23 of them with no `notes` attribute, so those are not recorded anywhere else), and 16 have unbalanced parentheses that cannot be resolved automatically.
translation: 仍殘留少量：28 個自由翻譯仍內嵌括號（其中 23 個沒有 `notes` 屬性，因此這些內容未記錄於其他任何地方），另有 16 個括號不成對、無法自動解決。

english: A small subset of sentences in the Grammar subcorpus have no word-by-word glosses (the original data does not include them).
translation: Grammar 子語料庫中有一小部分句子沒有逐詞詞義標注（原始資料未包含）。

english: A smaller portion includes morphosyntactic glosses.
translation: 較小的一部分包含形態句法詞義標注。

english: A source sentence offering alternatives — Sally likes x / y / z — becomes one `<S>` block per option, never a single block with the slashes retained.
translation: 提供替代選項的來源句子——Sally 喜歡 x / y / z——會為每個選項各建一個 `<S>` 區塊，絕不會是保留斜線的單一區塊。

english: A source sentence offering alternatives — `Sally likes x / y / z` — becomes one S block per option, never a single block with the slashes retained.
translation: 提供替代選項的來源句子 — `Sally likes x / y / z` — 會成為每個選項各一個 S 區塊，絕不會是保留斜線的單一區塊。

english: A source sentence with optional words — `x y (z)` — becomes two S blocks: `x y` and `x y z`.
translation: 帶有可選詞的來源句子 — `x y (z)` — 會成為兩個 S 區塊：`x y` 和 `x y z`。

english: A source sentence with optional words — x y (z) — becomes two `<S>` blocks, one for x y and one for x y z, each with glosses and translations matching its own variant (the x y block must not carry z's gloss).
translation: 帶有可省略詞的來源句子——x y (z)——會變成兩個 `<S>` 區塊，一個是 x y，一個是 x y z，各自帶有與其變體相符的詞義標注和翻譯（x y 區塊不得帶有 z 的詞義標注）。

english: A source's mark of uncertainty about a gloss it did give (`LIG?`, `他?`) is kept as written.
translation: 來源對其確實給出的詞義標注所表示的不確定標記（`LIG?`、`他?`）依原樣保留。

english: A source's own `??` or `?` marker is kept as written (POL-036).
translation: 來源本身的 `??` 或 `?` 標記依原樣保留（POL-036）。

english: A source's own marker for an untranscribed word (NTU's `X` / `XX`) is replaced by `<UNCLEAR/>`.
translation: 來源自己用來表示未轉寫詞的標記（NTU 的 `X` / `XX`）會以 `<UNCLEAR/>` 取代。

english: A space is added in sentences without word segmentation, but in word-segmented sentences (all in `jiu_jie_jiao_cai_nine_level_materials`) the parenthetical is left attached on purpose (step 10 below).
translation: 在未切分詞的句子中會加入空格，但在已切分詞的句子中（全部位於 `jiu_jie_jiao_cai_nine_level_materials`），括號內容刻意保持相連（見下方第 10 步）。

english: A spelling correction does not change an ID.
translation: 拼寫更正不會改變 ID。

english: A spelling variant does not double a word's length.
translation: 拼寫變體不會使一個詞的長度加倍。

english: A stale `revision` is not caught as an error — downloads simply keep fetching the old bytes, which is exactly what pinning is for and exactly why forgetting to update it is silent.
translation: 過時的 `revision` 不會被當成錯誤偵測出來——下載只會持續取得舊的位元組，這正是固定版本的目的，也正是忘記更新它時不會有任何警示的原因。

english: A stale or missing dictionary degrades the classifier quietly — it simply attests fewer words, so more `'` characters fall through to the default reading.
translation: 過時或缺少的辭典會悄悄降低分類器的效能——它只是佐證的詞變少，於是有更多 `'` 字元落入預設解讀。

english: A standard FORM is expected by much of the downstream tooling, but its absence is a soft validation finding.
translation: 許多下游工具預期會有標準 FORM，但缺少時只是軟性驗證發現。

english: A standardized gloss can be added as a separate `kindOf="standard"` translation.
translation: 可另外加入標準化的詞義標注，作為獨立的 `kindOf="standard"` 翻譯。

english: A standardized gloss can be added as a separate kindOf='standard' translation"); companion to POL-001's source-fidelity guarantee, applied to the gloss tier.
translation: 標準化的詞義標注可以作為另一個 kindOf='standard' 翻譯加入」）；是 POL-001 來源忠實保證的配套規定，應用於詞義標注層。

english: A step summary — no exit-code gate. corpus-metricspush to main + PRRegenerates statistics/ (including language_history.csv) and auto-commits on main; the documentation site rebuilds when it finishes.
translation: 步驟摘要——沒有結束代碼關卡。 corpus-metrics推送至 main + PR重新產生 statistics/（包括 language_history.csv）並在 main 上自動提交；完成後文件網站會重新建置。

english: A stepping stone for creating digital resources and applications, such as dictionaries, and grammar-check tools, tailored to these languages.
translation: 可作為專為這些語言打造的數位資源和應用程式的基礎（如字典和語法檢查工具）。

english: A stray `)` / `）` at the start of a form is dropped.
translation: 形式開頭零星的 `)` / `）` 會被捨棄。

english: A structural finding (schema, ids, tier relationships) states a fact about the XML that is fixable by definition, so a waiver there is always the wrong tool.
translation: 結構性的檢查結果（綱要、id、層級關係）陳述的是關於 XML 的事實，依定義就是可以修正的，因此在那裡使用豁免永遠是錯誤的工具。

english: A student transcription page is ready: https://claude.ai/artifact/2nBDcNWUcujmqFkNzTW71k (the maintainer must share it).
translation: 一個學生轉寫頁面已準備就緒：https://claude.ai/artifact/2nBDcNWUcujmqFkNzTW71k（必須由維護者分享）。

english: A successful build or XML check does not settle them.
translation: 建置成功或 XML 檢查通過並不能解決這些問題。

english: A systematic, source-derived rule goes in a reviewed decision table, `CodeAndDocs/standard_surface_decisions.tsv`.
translation: 系統性、源自來源的規則放在經審閱的決策表 `CodeAndDocs/standard_surface_decisions.tsv` 中。

english: A systematic, source-derived rule goes in a reviewed decision table, `standard_surface_decisions.tsv`, which `apply_manual_corrections.py` and `rebuild_xml.py` apply and which `normalize_sentence_standards.py` checks after `standardize.py` runs.
translation: 系統性、源自來源的規則放在經審閱的決策表 `standard_surface_decisions.tsv` 中，由 `apply_manual_corrections.py` 與 `rebuild_xml.py` 套用，並在 `standardize.py` 執行後由 `normalize_sentence_standards.py` 檢查。

english: A table row that matches no gloss fails the build.
translation: 表中任何一列若未匹配任何詞義標注，建置即失敗。

english: A table row whose printed word or gloss no longer matches stops the build.
translation: 若某個表格列的印刷詞或詞義標注已不再相符，則停止建置。

english: A table that wanted `g → ng` without turning `ng` into `nng` used to hop through a spare symbol — `ng → ɟ`, `g → ng`, `ɟ → ng` — because ordering was the only tool it had. `Amis_Church_113` did exactly that.
translation: 過去，一個想要 `g → ng` 又不想把 `ng` 變成 `nng` 的表，會借道一個備用符號——`ng → ɟ`、`g → ng`、`ɟ → ng`——因為順序是它唯一的工具。`Amis_Church_113` 正是這麼做的。

english: A text-only file normally contains one or more `<S>` elements.
translation: 純文字檔案通常包含一個或多個 `<S>` 元素。

english: A third column in the printed tables, headed "Sida", is transcribed but not published; see Notes and caveats.
translation: 印刷表格中標題為 "Sida" 的第三欄已轉寫但未發布；見注意事項。

english: A third reading and beyond carry their reading number: `-opt3`, `-opt4`, and so on (maintainer, 2026-09-10).
translation: 第三種及之後的讀法帶有其讀法編號：`-opt3`、`-opt4`，依此類推（維護者，2026-09-10）。

english: A third, across the corpus: a gloss for a single morpheme is written with dots, not hyphens — `(one.after.another)`, `long.time.ago`, `kill.with.boiling.water`.
translation: 第三項套用於整個語料庫：單一詞素的詞義標注以句點而非連字號書寫——`(one.after.another)`、`long.time.ago`、`kill.with.boiling.water`。

english: A third, applied across the corpus: a gloss for a single morpheme is written with dots, not hyphens.
translation: 第三項套用於整個語料庫：單一詞素的詞義標注以句點而非連字號書寫。

english: A tier carrying any `ver` FORM must carry exactly one FORM of that `kindOf` without `ver` — the reading the variants vary from.
translation: 帶有任何 `ver` FORM 的層，必須恰有一個不帶 `ver` 的同 `kindOf` FORM——即變體所依據的讀法。

english: A tier carrying any variant must carry exactly one FORM of that `kindOf` without `ver` — the base the variants vary from (V149 HARD).
translation: 帶有任何變體的層，必須恰好帶有一個該 `kindOf` 且不帶 `ver` 的 FORM — 也就是變體所依據的基底（V149 HARD）。

english: A tier may carry several variants; it may not carry several bases, because then no variant knows what it varies from.
translation: 一個層可以帶有多個變體；但不可以帶有多個基底，因為那樣就沒有任何變體知道自己是從哪個基底變化而來。

english: A tool that expects a gloss on every W will find most of this corpus empty at that tier.
translation: 預期每個 W 都有詞義標注的工具，會發現本語料庫在該層大多是空的。

english: A tool that reads only the text before a FORM's first child element would undercount further (142,615), dropping every word after the first `<UNCLEAR/>` of a sentence.
translation: 只讀取 FORM 第一個子元素之前文字的工具會進一步少算（142,615），漏掉句子中第一個 `<UNCLEAR/>` 之後的每個詞。

english: A translation is tagged `zho`, unless an override names another language or the "translation" is the sentence itself (then the language's own ISO code).
translation: 翻譯標記為 `zho`，除非覆寫指定了另一種語言，或該「翻譯」就是句子本身（此時使用該語言自己的 ISO 代碼）。

english: A translation whose entire text is `unan` is not published, at any level — it recorded that the transcriber supplied nothing.
translation: 全文僅為 `unan` 的翻譯在任何層級都不發布——它記錄的是轉寫者沒有提供任何內容。

english: A translator missing from `CodeAndDocs/contributors.tsv` stops the build.
translation: 若有譯者不在 `CodeAndDocs/contributors.tsv` 中，建置即停止。

english: A typo'd repo name fails loudly rather than silently declaring nothing.
translation: 打錯的儲存庫名稱會明確報錯，而不是默默地什麼也沒宣告。

english: A validator run tells you `V135 trailing_punct_mismatch: 2` and points at a findings CSV.
translation: 驗證器的執行結果會告訴你 `V135 trailing_punct_mismatch: 2`，並指向一份發現 CSV。

english: A variant FORM has no W or M tier of its own, so it cannot carry the second gloss.
translation: 變體 FORM 沒有自己的 W 或 M 層，因此無法帶有第二個詞義標注。

english: A variant must look like a spelling variant of its own tier's base — overlapping it closely, or short along with it, and neither more than twice the other's length.
translation: 變體必須看起來像其所屬層基準形式的拼寫變體——與之高度重疊，或與之同樣很短，且任一方的長度都不超過另一方的兩倍。

english: A variant reading is written `ver="alt"` on a FORM whose `kindOf` names its tier — `kindOf="original" ver="alt"` is a variant of the original tier, `kindOf="standard" ver="alt"` of the standard.
translation: 變體讀法寫成在 FORM 上加 `ver="alt"`，其 `kindOf` 指明所屬的層 — `kindOf="original" ver="alt"` 是原始層的變體，`kindOf="standard" ver="alt"` 是標準層的變體。

english: A verdict whose recorded glosses no longer match the build is refused and printed, not applied.
translation: 若某項裁定所記錄的詞義標注與建置結果不再相符，則予以拒絕並印出，不予套用。

english: A waiver reclassifies the finding HARD → WAIVED: it stays in the findings CSV and in the printed summary, and stops failing the build.
translation: 豁免將該檢查結果由 HARD 重新分類為 WAIVED：它仍保留在檢查結果 CSV 與印出的摘要中，但不再使建置失敗。

english: A waiver that matches nothing does not fail the run.
translation: 不符合任何結果的豁免不會使執行失敗。

english: A waiver whose finding has been fixed does not fail anything — tidy it with `waivers.py prune` when convenient.
translation: 若某項豁免所對應的發現已被修正，不會導致任何失敗——方便時用 `waivers.py prune` 整理即可。

english: A warning is a prompt for human review (likely a mislabeled language/dialect or noisy source text), not a build failure.
translation: 警告是提示人工審查的訊號（可能是語言/方言標錯或來源文字雜訊多），而不是建置失敗。

english: A well-developed intellectual infrastructure, including active collaborations with organizations like the Indigenous Languages Research and Development Foundation, which helps drive language revitalization efforts.
translation: 完善的智識基礎設施，包括與原住民族語言研究發展基金會等組織的積極合作，其有助於推動族語復振工作。

english: A whole file with no multi-morphemic word anywhere is the reliable signal.
translation: 整個檔案中任何地方都沒有多詞素的詞，才是可靠的訊號。

english: A whole optional word — `x y (z)` — changes the W tier and the gloss alignment, so it becomes two `S` blocks (POL-026), the second taking the first's id plus `-opt`.
translation: 一個完整的可選詞 — `x y (z)` — 會改變 W 層和詞義標注的對齊，因此它會成為兩個 `S` 區塊（POL-026），第二個區塊採用第一個區塊的 id 加上 `-opt`。

english: A word containing `-` is split into one `M` per part.
translation: 含 `-` 的詞會切分為每部分一個 `M`。

english: A word is also treated as unreliably segmented when a morpheme gloss carries half a parenthesis — the transcription split a parenthesised multi-word unit across two morphemes, writing `(next-morning)` as `(next` + `morning)` — since half a gloss is not a gloss.
translation: 當某個詞素的詞義標注帶有半個括號時，該詞也被視為切分不可靠——轉寫把一個加括號的多詞單位拆到兩個詞素上，把 `(next-morning)` 寫成 `(next` + `morning)`——因為半個詞義標注不是詞義標注。

english: A word is collapsed only if: exactly one slash-word with `<M>` segmentation and no parenthesis (slash+paren mixes left for manual); every morpheme tier/gloss splits into 1 or the same N≥2; the free translation has no `/`; and exactly one alternative's reconstructed surface (dashes/clitics removed) matches a whitespace token of the S-level FORM — the uttered form (0 or >1 ⇒ ambiguous, left for manual).
translation: 只有在以下條件成立時，詞才會被收斂：恰好一個有 `<M>` 切分且不含括號的斜線詞（斜線加括號的混合留待人工處理）；每個詞素層／詞義標注拆分為 1 個或相同的 N≥2 個；自由翻譯沒有 `/`；且恰好一個替代形式重建後的表面形式（移除連字號／附著詞）與 S 層級 FORM 中以空白分隔的某個詞元相符 — 即說出的形式（0 個或多於 1 個 ⇒ 有歧義，留待人工處理）。

english: A word is repaired only if all guards hold: a unique candidate piece-sequence among same-language source duplicates; letter fidelity (boundary markers are added, letters never change — verified); per-tier gloss counts equal to the piece count; and PHON reproducibility (converting the word's current FORM through `add_phonology.py`'s own `phonologize` must exactly regenerate its existing PHON before the mapping is trusted to produce the new per-morpheme PHONs — since 2026-08-10 this uses the real pipeline profile, so it passes on current-pipeline PHON and skips older vintages).
translation: 只有在所有防護條件都成立時才修復一個詞：在同語言的來源重複出現中有唯一的候選片段序列；字母忠實（只加入邊界標記，字母從不改變——已驗證）；每個層的詞義標注數等於片段數；以及 PHON 可重現性（將該詞目前的 FORM 透過 `add_phonology.py` 自己的 `phonologize` 轉換，必須能完全重新產生其現有的 PHON，才信任該對應來產生新的逐詞素 PHON——自 2026-08-10 起此步驟使用真正的流程設定檔，因此對目前流程產生的 PHON 能通過，對較舊版本則會略過）。

english: An Amis sentence that appeared in both the Amis–English and the Amis–Chinese translation memory is one sentence carrying both translations.
translation: 同時出現在阿美語–英語和阿美語–中文翻譯記憶庫中的阿美語句子，成為帶有兩種翻譯的一個句子。

english: An Amis-Chinese S joins an Amis-English S when their Amis original FORMs are identical (1,800), or, failing that, equal once spaces, commas, periods and dashes are ignored (53; ruling: "commas and periods and dashes can be ignored"), plus one ruled join in `CodeAndDocs/ruled_joins.csv` (U001151 into U002332, keeping "Faloco'"; ruling: "we clearly should join and should go with `Faloco'` and not `Faloco` on the join"; both Glosbe pages print `Falocoˈ`).
translation: 當阿美語–中文 S 與阿美語–英語 S 的阿美語原始 FORM 完全相同時（1,800 個），或在不相同時、忽略空格、逗號、句號和破折號後相等時（53 個；裁定："commas and periods and dashes can be ignored"），兩者即合併；另有 `CodeAndDocs/ruled_joins.csv` 中一項經裁定的合併（U001151 併入 U002332，保留 "Faloco'"；裁定："we clearly should join and should go with `Faloco'` and not `Faloco` on the join"；兩個 Glosbe 頁面都印作 `Falocoˈ`）。

english: An M is never created just so that a word has one.
translation: 絕不會只為了讓某個詞有一個 M 而建立 M。

english: An M's FORM and PHON (both tiers) are converted only when (a) the M's original FORM is exactly one bracket group `<X>`, (b) that group occurs literally inside the parent W FORM (so the brackets are genuine infix notation, not a word-level code-switch/noise marker), and (c) removing all bracket groups from the W FORM leaves host letters beyond clitic chunks.
translation: 只有在以下條件成立時，M 的 FORM 與 PHON（兩層）才會被轉換：(a) 該 M 的原始 FORM 恰好是一個括號組 `<X>`，(b) 該括號組逐字出現在上層 W FORM 中（因此該括號確實是中綴記號，而非詞層級的語碼轉換／雜訊標記），以及 (c) 從 W FORM 中移除所有括號組後，除附著詞片段之外仍留有宿主字母。

english: An `<M>` records parsing that was actually done.
translation: `<M>` 記錄的是實際做過的剖析。

english: An `<S>` may be empty when an utterance has not yet been transcribed, although the validator reports this as a soft finding.
translation: 當話語尚未轉寫時，`<S>` 可以是空的，但驗證器會將此列為軟性發現。

english: An `<S>` with no `<FORM>` — an untranscribed-audio shell — never counts, because there is no text to segment.
translation: 沒有 `<FORM>` 的 `<S>`——即未轉寫錄音的空殼——永遠不計入，因為沒有可切分的文本。

english: An `AUDIO` with no `@file` and no `TEXT/@audio` is an orphan.
translation: 既沒有 `@file`、也沒有 `TEXT/@audio` 的 `AUDIO` 是孤立的。

english: An `M` with infix-shaped FORM (`-X-`) requires the parent `W` to have a `TRANSL` carrying an angle-bracket gloss (`<…>`).
translation: FORM 為中綴形式（`-X-`）的 `M`，要求其父 `W` 具有帶角括號詞義標注（`<…>`）的 `TRANSL`。

english: An `S` may have at most one `FORM` with `kindOf="original"`.
translation: 一個 `S` 最多只能有一個 `kindOf="original"` 的 `FORM`。

english: An `S` that has any `FORM` must have one with `kindOf="original"`.
translation: 具有任何 `FORM` 的 `S`，必須有一個 `kindOf="original"` 的 `FORM`。

english: An `S` with no `FORM` is never counted: an untranscribed-audio shell has no text to segment, and V010 already reports it.
translation: 沒有 `FORM` 的 `S` 永遠不計入：未轉寫錄音的空殼沒有可切分的文本，而且 V010 已經會列出它。

english: An absent gloss is the honest record of an absent source gloss.
translation: 缺少的詞義標注，如實記錄了來源中缺少的詞義標注。

english: An accent that merely appeared in the sample was therefore treated as an orthographic letter, preserved — and then had no row in `Orthographies/Ortho113/<Language>.tsv` to map through, so it starred.
translation: 因此，一個只是出現在樣本中的重音符號就被當作書寫系統中的字母而保留下來——然後在 `Orthographies/Ortho113/<Language>.tsv` 中卻沒有可供對應的列，於是被標上星號。

english: An added file has an empty baseline and therefore must have no HARD findings.
translation: 新增的檔案基準為空，因此必須沒有任何 HARD 發現。

english: An added file has an empty baseline, so it must be clean.
translation: 新增的檔案基準為空，因此必須乾淨無誤。

english: An additional repeated translation was matched using the full source sentence.
translation: 另有一個重複的翻譯是利用完整的來源句子比對出來的。

english: An audio-only file may instead contain document-level `<AUDIO>` elements and no sentences.
translation: 純錄音檔案則可改為包含文件層級的 `<AUDIO>` 元素，而沒有句子。

english: An earlier audit recommended making `maha-ku`/`musa-ku`/`mpuuyas-ku` consistent with the 26 hyphenated spellings elsewhere.
translation: 先前的一次稽核建議將 `maha-ku`/`musa-ku`/`mpuuyas-ku` 改為與其他地方 26 個帶連字號的拼寫一致。

english: An earlier note in this file that `Yami_Wakelin_113.tsv` "should not be taken seriously" referred to a different, long-deleted table of the same name, whose single rule deleted hyphens and mapped no letters; nothing of it survives here.
translation: 本檔案先前一則說 `Yami_Wakelin_113.tsv`「should not be taken seriously」的註記，指的是另一個早已刪除的同名表格，其唯一規則是刪除連字號，且沒有對應任何字母；它在此沒有任何殘留。

english: An earlier pass had recorded it as 1934; the issue cover reads "Vol.
translation: 先前一輪處理將其記為 1934 年；該期封面印有 "Vol.

english: An earlier pass read Wu's `'` as the glottal stop /ʔ/ and mapped it to Ortho113's `^`; that was reverted in review.
translation: 先前一輪處理曾將 Wu 的 `'` 視為喉塞音 /ʔ/ 並對應到 Ortho113 的 `^`；此做法已在審查中撤回。

english: An earlier release shipped a `standard` tier produced by `Yami_Wakelin_113.tsv`, a "conversion table" whose only rule deleted hyphens and which mapped no letters at all.
translation: 較早的版本附帶一個由 `Yami_Wakelin_113.tsv` 產生的 `standard` 層，那是一個唯一規則是刪除連字號、完全沒有對應任何字母的「轉換表」。

english: An earlier version of this corpus gave every word a single `<M>` mirroring the word, which asserted a monomorphemic analysis the author never made.
translation: 本語料庫的早期版本為每個詞都提供一個鏡像該詞的單一 `<M>`，這等於宣稱了作者從未作出的單一詞素分析。

english: An edit record carries no standard FORM and no PHON, so both are regenerated from the edited original.
translation: 編輯紀錄不帶標準 FORM，也不帶 PHON，因此兩者都從編輯後的原始層重新產生。

english: An embedded `Corpora/Virginia_Fey_Dictionary` checkout is detected automatically. `FORMOSANBANK_ROOT` selects another tools checkout and `PYTHON` selects its interpreter.
translation: 內嵌的 `Corpora/Virginia_Fey_Dictionary` checkout 會被自動偵測。`FORMOSANBANK_ROOT` 選擇另一個工具 checkout，`PYTHON` 選擇其直譯器。

english: An empty table is not a no-op: `standardize` still resolves the source profile through the naming convention (`<Language>_<Scheme>_113.tsv` → `Orthographies/Ortho94/<Language>.tsv`), so accents are still removed and capital variants still derived in every case.
translation: 空的轉換表並非毫無作用：`standardize` 仍會透過命名慣例（`<Language>_<Scheme>_113.tsv` → `Orthographies/Ortho94/<Language>.tsv`）解析來源書寫系統設定檔，因此在所有情況下仍會移除重音符號並衍生大寫變體。

english: An error log reports missing audio.
translation: 會有一份錯誤日誌回報缺少的錄音。

translation: 例如「Southern」（南勢），是阿美語的一個方言。

english: An existing rights claim in published XML is never removed or weakened on the grounds that the reviewer could not find its evidence.
translation: 已發布 XML 中既有的權利主張，絕不會因審查者找不到其證據而被移除或削弱。

english: An existing rights claim is never weakened because a reviewer could not find its evidence. The evidence lives with the maintainer, not in this repository. Escalate; do not downgrade.
translation: 現有的權利主張絕不會因為審查者找不到其證據而被弱化。證據由維護者保管，而不在本儲存庫中。請向上呈報；不要降級。

english: An infix `<x>` becomes its own `M` written `-x-` with gloss `<X>`, and the root keeps a hyphen where the infix was removed (e.g. `ʃ<uŋ>kaʃ` → root `ʃ-kaʃ` plus infix `-uŋ-`).
translation: 中綴 `<x>` 成為獨立的 `M`，寫作 `-x-`，詞義標注為 `<X>`，而詞根在移除中綴之處保留一個連字號（例如 `ʃ<uŋ>kaʃ` → 詞根 `ʃ-kaʃ` 加上中綴 `-uŋ-`）。

english: An infixed root keeps a gap hyphen and the infix is written `-X-` (`t<um>a-túturu` → `t-a`, `-um-`, `túturu`); each clitic morpheme keeps a leading `=` (`te=musu` → `te`, `=musu`).
translation: 帶中綴的詞根保留一個空位連字號，中綴寫作 `-X-`（`t<um>a-túturu` → `t-a`、`-um-`、`túturu`）；每個附著詞素保留前置的 `=`（`te=musu` → `te`、`=musu`）。

english: An inline Python check reads `CodeAndDocs/introduction_lexemes.json` and exits with status 2 if any record names a transcription group other than `Asai2026` or `Tsuchida1976`.
translation: 一段行內 Python 檢查會讀取 `CodeAndDocs/introduction_lexemes.json`，若有任何紀錄指名 `Asai2026` 或 `Tsuchida1976` 以外的轉寫群組，則以狀態 2 結束。

english: An inline Python step writes `provenance.json` with the FormosanBank checkout's `git rev-parse HEAD` (without Git metadata it keeps the previous file and prints a warning).
translation: 一個內嵌的 Python 步驟以 FormosanBank 檢出副本的 `git rev-parse HEAD` 寫出 `provenance.json`（若沒有 Git 中繼資料，則保留先前的檔案並印出警告）。

english: An item marked with several dialects goes into each of their files, and a reading marked for one dialect goes into that file only.
translation: 標有多個方言的項目會放入每個對應方言的檔案，而只標記一個方言的讀法只放入該檔案。

english: An optional `notes` attribute can record a transcription note, review status, or other human-readable qualification — including what the source actually printed where the tier departs from it.
translation: 選用的 `notes` 屬性可記錄轉寫說明、審查狀態或其他供人閱讀的限定說明——包括在該層與來源不同之處，來源實際印出的內容。

english: An optional morpheme becomes separate `S` blocks when the source glosses it, so the two readings would be glossed differently: Seediq-Chang's `h-(um)-uwa` is `huwa` 怎樣 or `h-um-uwa` 怎樣-AF, and NTU Bunun's `kangavas(=an)` is `kangavas` 'mango' or `kangavas=an` 'mango=MED.NOM'.
translation: 當來源為可選詞素做了詞義標注，使兩種讀法的詞義標注會不同時，該可選詞素就會成為獨立的 `S` 區塊：Seediq-Chang 的 `h-(um)-uwa` 是 `huwa` 怎樣 或 `h-um-uwa` 怎樣-AF，而 NTU 布農語的 `kangavas(=an)` 是 `kangavas` 'mango' 或 `kangavas=an` 'mango=MED.NOM'。

english: An optional phrase (`(nau tu)`, `(kane ku butulu)?`) is split the same way (POL-026); a record with both gets `-opt3` (phrase) and `-opt4` (both).
translation: 可選片語（`(nau tu)`、`(kane ku butulu)?`）以相同方式拆分（POL-026）；兼具兩者的記錄得到 `-opt3`（片語）和 `-opt4`（兩者）。

english: And `tanah tunux` 'red head' is the narrator's idiom for the Japanese period, which the free translation renders as 日本時代.
translation: 此外，`tanah tunux`「紅頭」是講述者對日治時期的慣用說法，意譯將其譯為日本時代。

english: And our many contributors.
translation: 以及許多的貢獻者。

english: And the article's own errata delete `?` exactly twice (A42, A43), both times word-finally before the vowel-initial word `u`, which is the hiatus where a glottal transition is automatic and need not be written; everywhere else they leave it.
translation: 而文章自己的勘誤恰好刪除了兩次 `?`（A42、A43），兩次都在詞尾、位於以母音開頭的詞 `u` 之前，也就是喉塞過渡會自動出現而不必書寫的母音連續處；其他地方則都保留。

english: And the article's own errata delete `?` exactly twice, both times before a vowel-initial word — the hiatus where a glottal is automatic — and leave it everywhere else.
translation: 而文章自己的勘誤恰好刪除了兩次 `?`，兩次都在以母音開頭的詞之前——也就是喉塞音會自動出現的母音連續處——其他地方則都保留。

english: And two word glosses live in `CodeAndDocs/alternative_decisions.json` rather than the snapshot, because they belong to a split sentence's branch.
translation: 另有兩個詞的詞義標注存放在 `CodeAndDocs/alternative_decisions.json` 而非快照中，因為它們屬於某個被分割句子的分支。

english: Any HARD finding other than the accepted `G001` on `078S4W19` fails, whatever rule it comes from.
translation: 除了 `078S4W19` 上已接受的 `G001` 之外，任何 HARD 發現項都會導致失敗，無論來自哪條規則。

english: Any XML parser returns the angle brackets as text.
translation: 任何 XML 剖析器都會將角括號當作文字傳回。

english: Any `*_warnings.csv` a run leaves behind is a per-run report (POL-033): read it, then delete it.
translation: 執行後留下的任何 `*_warnings.csv` 都是單次執行的報告（POL-033）：閱讀後即刪除。

translation: 任何 `standardize_warnings.csv` 都會寫入 `XML/`。

english: Any additional dialect-related context that doesn't fit on the `dialect` attribute is recorded in the accompanying corpus documentation.
translation: 任何無法放進 `dialect` 屬性的其他方言相關脈絡，都記錄在隨附的語料庫文件中。

english: Any change to a corpus's licence, in either direction, fails `.github/workflows/rights-comparison.yaml`, which compares the head against the base ref exactly as `token-comparison.yaml` does.
translation: 對語料庫授權的任何變更，無論方向為何，都會使 `.github/workflows/rights-comparison.yaml` 失敗；該工作流程將 head 與 base ref 進行比較，方式與 `token-comparison.yaml` 完全相同。

translation: 未來任何 ASR 衍生檔都需要有自己經審查的輸出，如 Joshua 在 #168 中所指定。

english: Any mismatch stops the build with nothing deleted.
translation: 任何不符都會使建置停止，且不刪除任何東西。

english: Any non-empty delta is a failure.
translation: 任何非空的差集都算失敗。

english: Any normalized text appearing in two or more `<S>` elements becomes a finding, classified by how many distinct files it spans:
translation: 任何出現在兩個或以上 `<S>` 元素中的正規化文字都會成為一筆檢查結果，並依其橫跨的不同檔案數分類：

translation: 任何其他規則都屬未審閱：其 SOFT 與 WARN 發現項會列於 `qc-summary.md` 中的 "Findings from rules this corpus has not reviewed" 之下，在建置期間以 `NOTE:` 印出，且不會使建置停止。

english: Any warnings go to `CodeAndDocs/cleaner_warnings.csv`, which a run with none removes (none is committed).
translation: 所有警告都寫入 `CodeAndDocs/cleaner_warnings.csv`，若執行時沒有警告則移除該檔（未提交任何此類檔案）。

english: Any warnings go to `XML/standardize_warnings.csv` (none is committed).
translation: 所有警告都寫入 `XML/standardize_warnings.csv`（未提交任何此類檔案）。

translation: 任何重新標準化 WakelinTexts 的人都必須重新執行此步驟——這正是它放在 `generate_xml.sh` 內、而不是期望某人記得去做的原因。

translation: 任何重建其中某個語料庫的人都應預期會出現該差異，並將其解讀為修正生效，而不是退步。

english: Anyone treating this corpus as a complete run of the series should check those six against the live blog.
translation: 任何人若將本語料庫視為該系列的完整收錄，應對照即時部落格檢查這六個編號。

translation: 任何使用您資料的人必須承認 您是資料的作者及擁有者。

translation: 未通過任何防護條件者會被略過，並仍列於 `empty_M_repair_partition.csv`。

translation: 除了下下一個項目所述的來源語言標籤外，沒有任何內容是依一概適用的規則刪除的——每一項排除都是有記錄的決定（`dictionary_ledger.csv` 中的排除項與 `standard_surface_decisions.tsv`）。

english: Apostrophes are assumed glottal in Amis, Atayal, Paiwan and Sakizaya, and converted to quotation marks in Seediq; see "Apostrophe (`'`) handling" under "What each step does".
translation: 在阿美語、泰雅語、排灣語和撒奇萊雅語中，撇號被假定為喉塞音；在賽德克語中則轉換為引號；見「各步驟說明」下的「撇號（`'`）處理」。
